ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels accounting for approximately 98% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to discrete focal spots and trailing edge highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation field. High-contrast white circular blobs are distributed across both lobes: a linear sequence of approximately seven spots on the left mid-lobe and a dense, irregular white cluster on the extreme right tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped central notch with a narrow vertex and a depth approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the full trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits a prominent deep indentation approximately midway between the notch and the tip. The right lobe shows more consistent, small-amplitude jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the notch to the tips. Both lobes display an upward curvature, with the left lobe terminating in a slightly more acute distal point than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete white circular pixel clusters scattered across both lobes. A prominent cluster of larger high-intensity white masses (3D texture) is located on the right distal tip, with a smaller cluster on the far-left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast horizontal and diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the mid-right lobe, lacking the high-contrast definition of the white circular spots.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes, particularly the right. A distinct semi-circular notch is present on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific spatial arrangement of white punctate marks across the dark ventral background forms a unique, constellation-like pattern.
